content.short: Charity project with a focussing on NFTs, live streams, and creating a local sanctuary for the critically endangered Axolotl species.
content.description:
ADA Axolotls is a a meme coin charity project built on Cardano with a unique approach to community submitted NFTs, live streams, and create a local sanctuary for the critically endangered Axolotl species.

Members can gain whitelist spots by creating community content, NFTs, and participate in saving the Axolotls! Our team has experience in operating aquatic aquariums and hope to create a significant impact on their survivability both directly and by raising awareness.

But gosh these things are just so cute!.....but in an ugly kind way XD
